# ADR-NNN: <Decision title>

## Status

proposed | accepted | superseded | suspended. When superseded, name the
superseding record and date.

## Context

The technical situation and, above all, the governing BDRs: name them and
state how each constrains this decision. An ADR without a BDR link should
justify why the constraint is purely technical.

## Decision

The technical commitment, as testable statements: technology choices,
deployment topology, integration style, boundaries (for example "the
server binds to 127.0.0.1 only"). State what is explicitly out of scope.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, what becomes harder, which alternatives were rejected
and why. Record violations that count as architecture breaches (for
example "binding 0.0.0.0 is an architecture violation") so agents can
recognize them.
